messages.subject: Datatable Row Colour Not Applied
parts:
Despite specifying the CSS for changing the selection colour to green, the row selection colour remains blue.

library(shiny)
library(DT)
shinyApp(
ui = fluidPage(
tags$style(HTML("
table.dataTable tbody .selected,
table.dataTable .selected td.sorting_1,
table.dataTable .selected td.sorting_2,
table.dataTable .selected td.sorting_3,
div.DTS tbody .even.selected,
.table-striped tbody>.selected:nth-child(odd)>td,
.table-striped tbody>.selected:nth-child(even)>td {
background-color: green;
}
")),
fluidRow(DT::dataTableOutput('tbl'))
),
server = function(input, output, session) {
output$tbl = DT::renderDataTable(iris, selection = list(which = 'row'))
}
)

How can I change it to another colour ?

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Datatable Row Colour Not Applied
parts:
You probably need the !important flag (cf
https://github.com/rstudio/DT/blob/master/inst/htmlwidgets/lib/datatables/css/default/dataTables.extra.css).

Regards,
Yihui
